## Description

I have a problem with one of my Selfmade supras.
all my PCB´s, and parts are from the same order. I replaced some parts sometimes, but it didnt solve my problem.
I Tryed different FW Versions. Right now its the 2.3.0.


My problem:

At the beginning after a restart the Miner working well. After some time (sometimes 5min, sometimes 30min, sometimes 4hours...) the hashrate is displayed at a fix point. It does not move up or down. (See Picture).

i cant reproduce this bug. I tried different Parts, different Pools, differend FW Versions, different WiFi.

The PCB´s are from JLCPCB (mostly prosoldered). I got 10pcs, and a friend some more. he dont have any Problems, and i have problems with 2 PCB´s. others working well.
